description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Smarty_CacheResource_Mysql' that implements a cache resource for Smarty templates using MySQL as storage. It includes methods for fetching, saving, and deleting cached content, and manages database connections and queries.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Mysql
classes.description: A class implementing Smarty's cache resource using MySQL, providing methods to fetch, save, and delete cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database connection and prepares SQL statements for cache operations.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieves cached content and its modification time from the database.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the modification timestamp of cached content.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores content in the cache database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries based on provided filters or truncates the entire cache.
